patch_description:
The current ansatz uses parity-based parameter sharing (ry_even, ry_odd, rz_even, rz_odd, cry_long_a, cry_long_b) which reduces parameters to 6 unique keys. However, this aggressive sharing may limit expressivity.

The prior high-performing program (score 0.91) used more granular parameter sharing with 3 unique keys (ry_init, rz_main, ry_final, cry_nnn) but achieved better accuracy (0.93 test vs 0.90 current).

This edit proposes a middle ground: use a hybrid approach with:
1. Moderate parameter sharing on single-qubit rotations (2 keys instead of 4)
2. Simplified two-qubit entanglement with fewer but more focused parametrized gates
3. Removal of some fixed CZ gates to reduce depth while keeping parametrized CRY gates for flexibility

This should improve test accuracy and generalization gap while keeping parameters reasonable.
